title: Run automated accessibility checks
description: Add a documented automated accessibility checker and scan representative primary screens and states, resolving serious findings rather than suppressing rules generically.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected checker and official usage documentation are recorded in the repository
Automated scans cover representative project, geometry, content, preparation, calibration, backup, recovery, offline, dialog, error, and empty states
No serious automated violations remain in tested states
Any targeted exception documents exact rule, element, rationale, owner, and resolution plan
No rule is disabled globally merely to make scans pass

steps.details: Select a maintained checker compatible with the existing browser/component tests, install it, and cite official setup and rule documentation.
Reuse public workflows and small fixtures to reach the named normal, warning, error, dialog, empty, and offline states.
Run scans after each state is stable and report rule, impact, selector, and help URL without broad exclusions.
Fix serious findings in the bounded state set and document any precise unresolved exception rather than suppressing a rule.
Execute the focused scan suite and confirm tested primary states have no serious violations.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; scan an intentionally bounded representative state matrix.
Automated checks complement keyboard and manual assistive-technology validation.
